parameters.jsCode:
// Un item por perfil. «actor» es el actor de Apify que lo lee e «input» su entrada.
// Para vigilar otra marca basta con cambiar los handles aquí.
const n = $('Config').first().json.max_por_perfil;
return [
  { platform: 'facebook',  profile: 'exito',          actor: 'apify~facebook-posts-scraper',
    input: { startUrls: [{ url: 'https://www.facebook.com/exito' }], resultsLimit: n } },
  { platform: 'instagram', profile: 'exito',          actor: 'apify~instagram-post-scraper',
    input: { username: ['exito'], resultsLimit: n } },
  { platform: 'threads',   profile: 'exito',          actor: 'apify~threads-profile-api-scraper',
    input: { usernames: ['exito'], resultsLimit: n } },
  { platform: 'tiktok',    profile: 'almacenesexito', actor: 'clockworks~tiktok-scraper',
    input: { profiles: ['almacenesexito'], resultsPerPage: n + 3, profileSorting: 'latest' } }, // +3: los fijados salen primero
  { platform: 'x',         profile: 'almacenesexito', actor: 'apidojo~twitter-scraper-lite',
    input: { twitterHandles: ['almacenesexito'], maxItems: Math.max(n, 5), sort: 'Latest' } },
  { platform: 'linkedin',  profile: 'grupoexito',     actor: 'apimaestro~linkedin-company-posts',
    input: { company_name: 'grupoexito', limit: n, sort: 'recent' } },
].map((json) => ({ json }));

parameters.query: select external_id, access_token from social_accounts where id = $1::uuid;

insert into rrss_monitor_posts (platform, profile, post_id, url, text, published_at, api_ref)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, nullif($6, '')::timestamptz, nullif($7, ''))
on conflict (platform, post_id) do update
   set api_ref = coalesce(excluded.api_ref, rrss_monitor_posts.api_ref), updated_at = now()
returning id, platform, profile, url, left(coalesce(text, ''), 700) as extracto,
          to_char(published_at at time zone 'America/Bogota', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') as fecha,
          (tg_message_id is null and status = 'nuevo') as pendiente_aviso;
update rrss_monitor_posts set tg_message_id = $2::bigint, status = 'notificado', updated_at = now() where id = $1::bigint;

parameters.query: update rrss_monitor_posts set draft_text = $2, status = case when status in ('nuevo','notificado','omitido') then 'borrador' else status end, updated_at = now() where id = $1::bigint returning id, draft_text, tg_message_id;
update rrss_monitor_posts set tg_prompt_message_id = $2::bigint where id = $1::bigint;
update rrss_monitor_posts set status = 'omitido', updated_at = now() where id = $1::bigint and status not in ('publicado','publicando');

update rrss_monitor_posts
   set status = 'publicando', comment_text = $2, updated_at = now()
 where id = $1::bigint
   and status <> 'publicado'
   and (status <> 'publicando' or updated_at < now() - interval '5 minutes')
returning id, platform, profile, post_id, url, api_ref, comment_text;

select external_id, access_token from social_accounts
where id = case $1 when 'linkedin' then $2::uuid when 'threads' then $3::uuid end;

update rrss_monitor_posts
   set status = $2, comment_external_id = nullif($3, ''), last_error = nullif($4, ''),
       commented_at = case when $2 = 'publicado' then now() else commented_at end, updated_at = now()
 where id = $1::bigint and $2 <> 'bloqueado';
